description: The figure is a horizontal bar chart illustrating how many participants referenced different evaluation criteria for a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system. The category axis is vertical on the left and labeled “Criterion,” listing (top to bottom) Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Overall Summary, Filters, and Veracity Explanation; the bars appear ordered from highest to lowest count. The value axis is horizontal and labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale with visible tick labels at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each criterion is represented by a single solid-colored bar (shaded from dark purple/blue at the top through teal/green toward the bottom) with a numeric label at the bar end: Relevant FCs is approximately 5 participants (dark purple bar), FC Summary is approximately 3 (dark blue bar), Relevance Explanation is approximately 3 (teal bar), Clarity and Simplicity is approximately 2 (green bar), Overall Summary is approximately 1 (light green bar), Filters is approximately 1 (yellow-green bar), and Veracity Explanation is approximately 0 (no visible bar length). No grouped or stacked segments are shown, and there are no additional annotations beyond the end-of-bar value labels.
